changes.summary: Recorded the Supreme Court stay restoring expanded SAVE access pending appeal without treating it as a merits judgment.
Recorded the D.C. Circuit's refusal of interim relief against a separate Anthropic designation while preserving the California ruling and unresolved merits.
Recorded resumed television-pool participation after credential restoration while preserving the temporary order and unresolved merits.
The effective final rule removes race- and sex-based presumptions and requires individualized disadvantage narratives for applicants and currently certified firms.
An interim final rule keeps core environmental-review requirements in regulation, moves internal procedures to a handbook and revises categorical exclusions.
Beginning October 26, covered explosives licensees and permittees must renew storage-facility notices annually and report when storage ends.
The final rule closes two 2003 interim proceedings, retains background-check and licensing rules, and ends specified delivery-verification requirements on October 26.
